title: The MachinEGG
description:
Welcome to The MachinEGG, a relaxing idle clicker game where eggs are your greatest treasure. Grow your farm, automate production, and see if you can earn enough to retire.

Buy chickens, feed them, collect their eggs, and take them to market. As your farm grows, unlock automation systems to streamline every step of the process and maximize your profits.

There's a normal mode and a speedrun mode to help you reach the top. Two replayable handicap challenges will change everything, and finally, there's an endless mode if you're still craving more chickens.

And please… treat the chickens well.

title: Woof Foow
description:
Welcome to Woof Foow, an exciting idle merge game where your love for dogs comes to life! Merge adorable pups to unlock new breeds and upgrade your pack. Watch as your cute companions evolve into stronger, more unique dogs as you progress through different levels. It's a fun and addictive journey with charming dog characters, perfect for casual gamers and dog lovers alike.

Key Features:
🎮Merge and evolve a variety of dog breeds
🎮Relaxing idle gameplay with endless upgrades
🎮Beautiful graphics and charming dog characters
🎮Easy to play but full of strategic depth
🎮Collect rewards even when you're offline
🎮Perfect for animal lovers and idle game fans

If you love dogs and enjoy casual idle merge games, Woof Foow is the perfect game for you! Download now and start growing your furry pack today!

title: Pow
description: Have you ever taken care your pet!? Feed it, clean it, play with it and watch it grow up while leveling up? This is all possible is this brand new Pow game for web and mobile. Feed, nurture and take care of your Pow. Play different games in games room and collect coins to buy food to feed your pow and buy decoration to customize your room! Also challenge your friends in 3 fun minigames!
